mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (status, total_amount, created_at, paid_at, cancelled_at) VALUES (#{order.status}, #{order.totalAmount}, #{order.createdAt}, #{order.paidAt}, #{order.cancelledAt})

SELECT id, status, total_amount, created_at, paid_at, cancelled_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' ORDER BY id DESC
